Based on the image provided, here is an extreme technical breakdown of the **Drivers Daily Log** (FMCSA Form) to assist with digital recreation. ### **1. Overall Layout & Dimensions** * **Orientation:** Portrait (Letter/A4 size). * **Structure:** Divided into three primary horizontal zones: 1. **Header Zone:** Top ~25% (Administrative data). 2. **Grid Zone:** Middle ~35% (The 24-hour graph). 3. **Footer/Summary Zone:** Bottom ~40% (Remarks, Shipping Docs, and Daily Totals). --- ### **2. Header Section (Top Down)** **Title Bar:** * **Left:** Large bold text: **"Drivers Daily Log"** * **Right:** Small instructional text: *"Original - File at home terminal. Duplicate - Driver retains for 8 days/his possession for 8 Days."* **Date & Cycle Line:** * **Label:** "(24 Hours)" * **Date Fields:** Three boxes separated by slashes: `[ (month) ] / [ (day) ] / [ (year) ]` * **Time Range:** Label **"From:"** (left aligned under date) and **"To:"** (right aligned). **Driver & Carrier Info (Row of Boxes):** * **Row 1 (Top):** Two side-by-side rectangular boxes. * Left Box Label (below): **"Total Miles Driving Today"** * Right Box Label (below): **"Total Mileage Today"** * **Row 2 (Middle):** One long rectangular box spanning the width. * Label (centered inside or below): **"Name of Carrier or Carriers"** * **Row 3 (Bottom):** One long rectangular box. * Label (below): **"Main Office Address"** * **Row 4 (Bottom):** One long rectangular box. * Label (below): **"Home Terminal Address"** * **Row 5 (Bottom):** One long rectangular box. * Label (below): **"Truck/Tractor and Trailer Numbers or License Plate(s)/State (show each unit)"** --- ### **3. The Grid Structure (The "Graph")** This is the core of the log. It uses a **4-row by 24-column** matrix. **Vertical Axis (Rows - Left Side Labels):** The rows are numbered 1–4 on the far left margin. 1. **Off Duty** 2. **Sleeper Berth** 3. **Driving** 4. **On Duty (not driving)** **Horizontal Axis (Time - Top Header):** * **Background:** Solid Black bar across the top of the grid. * **Text Color:** White. * **Midnight Markers:** The word **"mid night"** appears at the far left (start) and far right (end) of the black bar. * **Hourly Numbers:** Numbered **1 through 11**, then **"Noon"**, then **1 through 11** again. * *Note:* This represents a 24-hour cycle starting at Midnight (00:00), going through Noon (12:00), to the next Midnight (24:00). * **Column Headers (Far Right of Black Bar):** * **"miles"** * **"Total Hours"** **Internal Grid Lines:** * **Major Vertical Lines:** Separate each hour (every number). * **Minor Vertical Lines:** Each hour is subdivided into **4 equal parts** (representing 15-minute increments: :00, :15, :30, :45). * **Horizontal Lines:** Solid lines separate the four duty status rows. * **Right Margin:** A vertical column for entering totals (Miles and Total Hours per row). --- ### **4. Footer / Summary Section** **Remarks Section:** * **Header:** Bold label **"Remarks"** on the left. * **Field:** A large blank rectangular area with a solid bottom border for handwritten notes. **Shipping Documents Section:** * **Header:** Bold label **"Shipping Documents:"** on the left. * **Sub-field Label:** **"BOL or Manifest No."** (Bill of Lading) * **Field:** Blank line for entry. **Shipper & Commodity Section:** * **Header:** **"Shipper & Commodity"** * **Instructional Text (Italicized/Serif font):** *"Enter name of place you reported and where released from work and when and where each change of duty occurred."* * **Sub-instruction:** *"Use time standard of home terminal."* **Daily Totals Table (Bottom Grid):** This section is divided into two main columns: **"70 Hour/ 8 Day Drivers"** (left) and **"60 Hour/ 7 Day Drivers"** (right). Technical Specifications for Digital Recreation** * **Fonts:** * **Headers/Titles:** Sans-Serif (likely Arial or Helvetica), Bold. * **Body/Labels:** Sans-Serif, Regular weight. * **Instructions:** Serif font (likely Times New Roman) for the italicized shipping document instructions. * **Line Weights:** * **Outer Borders:** Heavier weight (1pt–1.5pt). * **Grid Lines:** Lighter weight (0.5pt). The 15-minute subdivision lines should be the thinnest or dotted/dashed if visible (in this specific image, they appear as solid but lighter than hour lines). * **Alignment:** * All text is left-aligned except for numbers in the time grid (centered in columns) and the "Total Miles/Hours" column (right-aligned or centered). * **Shading:** * Only the Time Axis header bar is solid black with white text. The rest of the form is white with black lines/text. This structure adheres to the standard FMCSA (Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration) requirements for a paper logbook prior to the mandatory ELD (Electronic Logging Device) mandate, though these forms are still used for backups or exemptions.
